title: cvpw qa/exemptions.json
description: Authored, dated, justified waivers. A waiver is a reviewed decision, not a mute button: it needs a reason, a date and an owner, and it appears in the delivery report (docs/SPEC.md V6).

check.description: The check id from docs/QA.md that is being waived.

target.description: What the waiver covers: a seam id, a shot id, a gate. Null means the whole check, which needs a stronger reason.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the waiver was granted.

reason.description: Why this is acceptable. A reason shorter than a sentence is not a reason.

observed.description: The measured value, so a later reader can judge whether the waiver is still proportionate.

threshold.description: The threshold it misses, copied from docs/QA.md.

owner.description: Who decided. An unowned waiver is nobody's decision.

expires.description: ISO 8601 date, or null for no expiry. A waiver that never expires should be either fixed or promoted into docs/QA.md with a reason.

affects.description: Advisory: what a reader should look at to judge the consequence.
